title: B.B.A. (Integrated BBA Programme) and Juris Doctor
description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 70 units of courses as follows:

sections.title: Required Courses
text: ACCT2111, 2121, DOTE2011, 2030, 2051, FINA2010, IBBA3040, MGNT2511, 2512, 4010 (capstone course), MKTG2010
Students must choose one concentration and take five or six courses among the courses prescribed under respective concentration areas as follows

subsections.title: one DOTE course at 3000 or above level, excluding the courses taken for fulfillment of requirement (i) or (ii)
15 units selected from
text: DOTE3010, FINA courses at 3000 or above level (with no more than three 1-unit FINA courses)

subsections.title: 3 units of DOTE/FINA/MGNT/MKTG courses at 2000 or above level; and

text: 12 units of DOTE/FINA/MGNT/MKTG courses at 3000 or above level, excluding the courses taken for fulfillment of requirement (i), with no more than three 1-unit FINA courses

notes.text: ACCT/DOTE/FINA/IBBA/MGNT/MKTG courses at 2000 and above level (excluding ACCT2111, 2121, IBBA3040, MGNT2511 and 2512) will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.
Students claiming Entrepreneurship Concentration are not allowed to declare Minor in Entrepreneurship and Innovation.
In addition to fulfilling the major programme requirement of the 1st degree, students are advised to take MGNT2611 as an elective course.
Students who have completed 18 units of LAWS courses will be exempted from 9 units of the equivalent courses in the Juris Doctor (JD) programme.

Students who choose one of the following concentrations: Finance, Entrepreneurship, Management of International Business, Human Resource Management, Marketing, or Big Data and Quantitative Marketing are required to complete a minimum of 73 units in order to fulfill the Major programme requirement.

additional_requirements.title: 2nd Degree: Juris Doctor
additional_requirements.description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 72 units of courses as follows:

subsections.title: Students are required to take at least 54 or 57 units of courses from the following[d]
Elective courses which are pre-requisites for subsequent admission to the Postgraduate Certificate in Laws (PCLL) Programme
Other elective courses offered under the JD programme
Elective courses offered under the Master of Laws programmes

notes.text: To be eligible to proceed to the fifth year for the JD degree, students must achieve a minimum CGPA (to be specified by the Faculty of Law) after completion of the fourth year. Students may choose to opt out from the double degree programme and complete a BBA degree or a BBA degree with a Minor in Law in four years, subject to the fulfillment of the requirements specified in the relevant study scheme.
Students who have completed LAWS1020 and 1030 in their first three years of studies in the BBA-JD programme will be exempted from LAWS6001.
Students may take LAWS6089 to substitute LAWS6006.
Students are required to take either LAWS6901 (3-unit course) or 6902 (6-unit course). The extra 3 units completed in LAWS6902 will be counted towards the total units required for graduation.

LAWS6012 and 6014 will no longer be pre-requisites for admission to the PCLL Programme with effect from 2021-22. Students may still take the two courses as elective courses offered under the JD Programme.
Students who have completed LAWS1041 and 1042 in their first three years of studies in the BBA-JD programme will be exempted from LAWS6021.
Students who have completed LAWS2131 and 2132 in their first three years of studies in the BBA-JD programme will be exempted from LAWS6023.
Students who have completed LAWS1020, 1030, 1041, 1042, 2131 and 2132 are required to complete a minimum of 63 units in order to fulfill the programme requirement.
